reuse.why: Changes the existing shared range helper and routes the budget template's private midpoint formula through it, though schedule-template and forecast keep their own number/range dispatch instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

duplication.why: Removes the one inline copy of the midpoint formula; the rule now exists only in getRangedAmountWorstCase.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, where the tree keeps schedule amount helpers used by server and client.

scope.why: Only the rule, its callers, a test and a release note.

maintainability.why: One small, well-named helper decides the expected amount everywhere; the remaining per-site ternaries are minor.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All range paths now call getRangedAmountWorstCase.

one_place.where: shared/schedules.ts getRangedAmountWorstCase, used by getScheduledAmount (client and server), forecast-schedules normalizeSchedule and budget schedule-template createScheduleList.
